summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from YPF Sociedad Anonima, a foreign private issuer, submitting its condensed interim consolidated financial statements as of March 31, 2026. The document contains routine periodic financial reporting with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing is an ordinary financial disclosure and does not describe any corporate event that would fit the special-situations categories.
